marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to southeast 25 knots near noon. Wind
southeast 25 tonight. Wind south 20 Saturday. Scattered flurries this morning. Visibility as low as 1
mile in flurries. Temperatures minus 1 rising to plus 5 Saturday
evening. <br/>

marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 metre or less building to 2 near midnight
then subsiding to 1 near noon Saturday.<br/>
